product.description: Genuine original Dell R8D7N replacement battery, 11.4V, Li-ion. Fits Dell Latitude 5400/5410/5500/5510, Precision 3540/3550 and Inspiron 7590/7591/7791 2-in-1 (2-in-1 variants only, not the standard clamshell models) (3-cell, 51Wh). faqs.question: How do I know this battery fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: These laptops can take either this R8D7N (11.4V, 51Wh) or the higher-capacity 4GVMP (7.6V, 68Wh) — they are not interchangeable. The part number on your old battery is the safest way to confirm. If you're unsure, send us a photo of the sticker on your battery on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.
